verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is that the Diagnostics CLI does not send its collected data to New Relic by default and uploads only if the user opts in (new-relic-docs-63). Community posts also describe turning off default-on log collection via environment variables or the Data Management Hub (new-relic-comm-1, comm-2, comm-3), though that controls customer data ingest more than vendor usage tracking. Missing for 10: documented opt-out of product usage telemetry for the newrelic CLI, UI and agents; a vendor-wide telemetry/privacy settings page; first-party docs for the log-collection opt-out; independent corroboration.
